title: How many Jimnys does it take to pull a G Wagen?

author: carwow
description:
Does a BMW E60 M5 have what it takes to bring down an almighty Dodge Viper Mk4 ACR?

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-1908

Who’s ready for a V10 showdown?! 

We’ve got Mat in the Mk4 Viper ACR, and he’s going head-to-head against Nick in the E60 M5! 

However, the Viper has a trick up its sleeve - it’s had a slight tune applied to it! But will it make much of a difference? Let’s check out the stats…

Starting with the Dodge, it’s powered by an 8.4-litre naturally aspirated V10 that usually produces 608hp and 760Nm. However, following the tune, it now produces 650hp and 800Nm! This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual, and it tips the scales at 1,533kg. All-in, the car is worth around £130,000.
